summary: No installer-side threat identified in tailwindcss-keyframe-kit@3.0.2
details: Review of the tailwindcss-keyframe-kit@3.0.2 npm package surfaced no indicators of installer-side harm. There is no evidence of install-time or import-time network fetches, no lifecycle scripts executing external code, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores), no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no silent-relay of caller-supplied data, no backdoor or persistence mechanism, and no self-propagation behavior. The package's contents are consistent with a standard Tailwind CSS plugin distribution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
